name: togail

attributes.attribute: a class of heroic tales in which a building is destroyed

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: togail is an Irish term that means destruction. The heading points the reader to the Destruction entry. Destructions are a class of heroic Irish tales in which a building is destroyed, often by fire. The best known of them is the Destruction of Da Derga's Hostel, which tells how a king's broken vows led to his death.

okr.objective: Explain togail as the Irish term for destruction.
